statement: Let (Mn, g) be a closed connected Riemannian manifold, where n ≥ 3 and Scalg = −1, and put Γ = π1(M). Let (Ω0, µ0) be a standard Borel probability space with a measure-preserving Γ-action; the one-point space is allowed. Suppose L0 is a countable set with finitely many free Γ-orbits and Fin : f M × Ω0 −→ ℓ2 (L0), Fin ℓ ≥ 0, X ℓ∈L0 (Fin ℓ )2 = 1 is equivariant, Borel in the transverse variable, and smooth along f M. Assume the following uniformity for this input. In charts lifted from a fixed finite atlas on M, with fixed inner buffers, the supports are locally finite with a uniform bound on their number, and all leafwise derivatives of the coordinate functions have uniform bounds. For each orbit representative ℓ there is a compact set Kℓ ⊂ f M such that supp Fin γℓ( · , ω) ⊂ γKℓ for all γ ∈ Γ and almost every ω. The bounds and compact sets in these assumptions may depend on the input. For every prescribed elementary function B and every finite number Emin, there are a standard Borel probability Γ-space (Ω, µ) extending (Ω0, µ0), a countable set L with finitely many free Γ-orbits, and equivariant leafwise data on f M × Ω: a metric h, a function ϕ, a positive density ρ, and a root probability map F with labels L. There are also E > Emin, an integer q ≥ n + 1, and a constant C = C(n, B) < ∞ such that, on an invariant conull set of transverse parameters, ρ ≤ dVg, W := log dVh ρ ≥ 0, S(h, ϕ) ≥ −C + 2  W − n 2 log E  + Eeh(F), eh(F)1/2 ≤ E−1/100 , E > B(q). (4.1) 25 Here the extension means that there is an equivariant measure-preserving map Ω → Ω0. All output objects are Borel transversely and smooth along leaves. In the same lifted charts, the coefficients of h, their derivatives of every order, and the coefficients of h−1 have uniform bounds; the function ϕ, the density ratio ρ/dVg, its reciprocal, and their derivatives of every order have uniform bounds. The coordinates of F have the same derivative and uniform local finiteness properties as the input. There are equivariant compact sets containing their supports, uniformly in the transverse parameter. All these output bounds may depend on the input and on the chosen finite construction. There is, in addition, a fixed Γ-invariant graph G on L, independent of the transverse parameter, of finite maximum degree ∆. It contains an edge between every pair of distinct labels that are simultaneously nonzero at any point of any leaf. We may take q ≥ max{n + 1, #(Γ\L), ∆ + 1} and a Borel equivariant coloring χ : L × Ω → {1, . . . , q} such that labels of graph distance one or two have different colors. The set L can be taken to consist of finitely many copies of L0. The constant C is independent of the manifold, metric, input family, all the uniform bounds just specified, and Emin.
